# webcpp::crypto

> Cryptographic primitives for C++20 on native, wasip2, wasip3 and Emscripten: AES-GCM, the AES block cipher, secp256k1 (BIP 340 Schnorr, ECDSA and recoverable signatures, ECDH, tweaks, ElligatorSwift, MuSig2, silent payments), Ed25519 and Ed25519ph (RFC 8032), X25519 (RFC 7748), their keys in SPKI, PKCS#8 (RFC 8410) and PEM, P-256 key pairs, ECDSA and ECDH on BearSSL, libsodium's crypto_kx, the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEADs, libsodium's secret boxes, boxes and sealed boxes, a random_device on the system's generator, a constant_time_equal and an erase_secret whose stores the optimiser keeps, each over a widely used, reviewed C library (BearSSL, OpenSSL, ctaes, libsecp256k1, libsodium) that the program names in its Jamfile. Hashing and HMAC are Boost.Hash2's; HKDF and password hashing are webcpp::hash's. Every failure is a boost::system::result value. Protocols (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Nostr) belong to domain libraries built on these primitives.

Generated by doc/tables/generate.py with the page's tables. Page: https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/

## webcpp::crypto

- [random_device](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-entropy): Unpredictable bytes from the operating system's or the browser's generator, and nothing else. Header <webcpp/crypto/random_device.hpp>. Backends: the system's generator (/webcpp/crypto//crypto) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: generate a session token, a password-reset link or an API key; draw an unbiased number in a range, such as a six-digit code.
  - fill: Fills `output_bytes` from the system's generator.
  - operator(): A value from the system's generator, as the standard library's random device gives one.
  - min: The smallest value `operator()` gives.
  - max: The largest value `operator()` gives.
  - entropy: The entropy of a value, in bits: every bit is the system's.
- [async_from_key, async_seal, async_open](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-async): AES-GCM's asynchronous from_key, seal and open, each completing through a post to the executor the call gives, with any Asio completion token. Header <webcpp/crypto/async.hpp>. Backends: BearSSL (/third_party//bearssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten; OpenSSL (/webcpp/crypto//openssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3. Use it to: seal or open a record inside an event loop without waiting.
  - async_from_key: Makes an AES-GCM object from its key bytes, asynchronously: `Cipher::from_key(key_bytes)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_seal: Seals a message in place, asynchronously: `aead_cipher.seal` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_open: Opens a message in place, asynchronously: `aead_cipher.open` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
- [async_from_secret, async_generate, async_sign, async_verify](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-async): Ed25519's asynchronous from_secret, generate, sign and verify with `crypto::eddsa`, each completing through a post to the executor the call gives, with any Asio completion token. Header <webcpp/crypto/async.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: sign and verify with Ed25519 in a coroutine.
  - async_from_secret: Makes an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair from its secret bytes, asynchronously: `Keypair::from_secret(secret_bytes)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_generate: Makes an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair from a fresh seed or scalar, asynchronously: `Keypair::generate()` run when the operation is initiated (the system's generator is drawn from then), its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_sign: Signs with an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair, asynchronously: `key_pair.sign(signing_scheme, signing_input)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_verify: Verifies an Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032's pure Ed25519), asynchronously, strictly: `crypto::verify<Backend>(crypto::eddsa, signature_value, message_bytes, public_key)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
- [async_agree](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-async): X25519's asynchronous agree, completing through a post to the executor the call gives, with any Asio completion token. Header <webcpp/crypto/async.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - async_agree: Agrees an X25519 shared secret, asynchronously: `curves::x25519::agree<Backend>` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
- [async_from_secret, async_generate, async_sign, async_verify, async_agree](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-async): P-256's asynchronous from_secret, generate, ECDSA sign and verify with `crypto::ecdsa_sha256`, of a message hashed with SHA-256 or `crypto::prehashed{digest}`, and ECDH's raw x, each completing through a post to the executor the call gives, with any Asio completion token. Header <webcpp/crypto/async.hpp>. Backends: BearSSL (/third_party//bearssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - async_from_secret: Makes an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair from its secret bytes, asynchronously: `Keypair::from_secret(secret_bytes)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_generate: Makes an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair from a fresh seed or scalar, asynchronously: `Keypair::generate()` run when the operation is initiated (the system's generator is drawn from then), its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_sign: Signs with an Ed25519 or a P-256 key pair, asynchronously: `key_pair.sign(signing_scheme, signing_input)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`.
  - async_verify: Verifies a P-256 ECDSA signature over SHA-256, asynchronously: `crypto::verify(crypto::ecdsa_sha256, signature_value, signing_input, public_key)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the message is hashed with SHA-256, as WebCrypto's ECDSA with SHA-256 verifies, or `crypto::prehashed{digest}` gives its digest.
  - async_agree: Agrees a P-256 shared secret, ECDH's raw x coordinate, asynchronously: `key_pair.agree(peer_public_key)` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`, as WebCrypto's `deriveBits` with ECDH on P-256 gives its 256 bits.
- [constant_time_equal](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-constant-time-equal): Compares two tags or MACs in constant time. Header <webcpp/crypto/constant_time_equal.hpp>. Backends: no backend (/webcpp/crypto//crypto) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: check a webhook's or an API's HMAC signature.
  - constant_time_equal: Whether two byte sequences are equal, in a time that does not depend on their contents.
- [erase_secret](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-erase-secret): Zeroes a buffer the program owns, a password, a key or a plaintext, with stores the optimiser keeps. Header <webcpp/crypto/erase_secret.hpp>. Backends: no backend (/webcpp/crypto//crypto) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - erase_secret: Zeroes every byte of a buffer the program owns, with stores the optimiser keeps.
- [error](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-errors): Every failure's value, fixed and never reused, in the category webcpp.crypto. Header <webcpp/crypto/error.hpp>. Backends: no backend (/webcpp/crypto//crypto) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: tell a forged message from a malformed one.
  - error_category: The category of every error.
  - make_error_code: Makes the `error_code` of an error, as its implicit conversion does.
  - message_of: The message of a value of error, or the unknown message for a value it does not define.
- [openssl_memory_resource, backends::openssl::install_memory_functions](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-memory-openssl): With `WEBCPP_CRYPTO_OPENSSL_MEMORY_RESOURCE`, natively, every allocation of OpenSSL's in the process goes to a `std::pmr::memory_resource` the program defines. Header <webcpp/crypto/backends/openssl.hpp>. Backends: OpenSSL (/webcpp/crypto//openssl) on native. Use it to: keep every allocation of OpenSSL's in the program's arena.
  - openssl_memory_resource: The resource every allocation of OpenSSL's in the process goes to, from any thread: declared by `<webcpp/crypto/backends/openssl.hpp>` under `WEBCPP_CRYPTO_OPENSSL_MEMORY_RESOURCE` and defined once by the program.
  - install_memory_functions: Installs webcpp's adapter as OpenSSL's memory functions, so that every allocation of OpenSSL's in the process goes to `openssl_memory_resource()`.
- [pem::armour, pem::unarmour](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-key-formats): PEM (RFC 7468): DER as base64 between `-----BEGIN <label>-----` and `-----END <label>-----`, lines of 64 characters and line feeds, as OpenSSL writes it; read strictly, so that any other text is `invalid_encoding`. Header <webcpp/crypto/pem.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: export or import an Ed25519 or X25519 key in the standard forms OpenSSL and WebCrypto use: SPKI and PKCS#8 (RFC 8410), as DER or PEM text.
  - armour: Writes DER as PEM under a label: `algorithm<Backend>::armour`.
  - unarmour: The DER of PEM under a label, strictly: `algorithm<Backend>::unarmour`.
  - armoured_size: The size of the PEM text of `der_size` bytes under a label of `label_size` characters: its first line, its lines of base64 of 64 characters each with a line feed, and its last line.

## webcpp::crypto::ciphers

- [ciphers::aes128, aes192, aes256](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-block): The AES block cipher on whole 16-byte blocks: a building block, not encryption of data. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aes.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aes_block.hpp>. Backends: OpenSSL (/webcpp/crypto//openssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3; ctaes (/third_party//ctaes) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: OpenSSL on native, Clang and GCC; OpenSSL on native, MSVC; ctaes on wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: turn a sequential id into an opaque reference.
  - from_key: Expands a key.
  - encrypt: Encrypts whole blocks in place.
  - decrypt: Decrypts whole blocks in place.
- [ciphers::gcm, aes128_gcm, aes256_gcm](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-gcm): AES-GCM, authenticated encryption in place with an incremental seal and an incremental open in two passes. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/gcm.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aes256_gcm.hpp>. Backends: BearSSL (/third_party//bearssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten; OpenSSL (/webcpp/crypto//openssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3. Default: OpenSSL on native, Clang and GCC; OpenSSL on native, MSVC; BearSSL on wasip2, wasip3; BearSSL on emscripten. Use it to: encrypt a database field, a cookie or a token at rest.
  - from_key: Expands a key into a new object.
  - async_from_key: Expands a key into a new object, asynchronously: `from_key` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of `crypto::async_from_key<gcm>(executor, key_bytes, token)`, which calls it.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - async_seal: Seals a message in place, asynchronously: `seal` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of `crypto::async_seal(executor, aead, iv_bytes, additional_data_bytes, data_bytes, token)`, which calls it.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.
  - async_open: Opens a message in place, asynchronously: `open` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of `crypto::async_open`, which calls it with the executor and the object before this function's arguments.
  - begin_seal: Begins an incremental seal: the IV and the whole additional data first, both read before this returns.
  - update: Encrypts the next piece of the message in place.
  - result: Ends the message with its tag.
  - begin_open: Begins an incremental open: the IV and the whole additional data first, both read before this returns, the IV kept for the second pass.
  - authenticate: The first pass: authenticates the next piece of the ciphertext, which is read and never written.
  - verify: Ends the first pass: checks the tag of the pieces authenticated, and on a match begins the second pass.
  - decrypt: The second pass: decrypts the next piece in place, the bytes `authenticate` read in the same place of the message.
  - end_open: Ends the open, whose message's state is wiped.
- [ciphers::chacha20_poly1305](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-chacha): RFC 8439's ChaCha20-Poly1305, authenticated encryption in place with a 12-byte nonce. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/chacha20_poly1305.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aead.hpp>. Backends: BearSSL (/third_party//bearssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten; OpenSSL (/webcpp/crypto//openssl) on native, wasip2, wasip3; libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - from_key: Makes an object under a key.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.
- [ciphers::chacha20_poly1305_original](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-chacha): The original ChaCha20-Poly1305, authenticated encryption in place with an 8-byte nonce a counter numbers. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/chacha20_poly1305.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aead.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - from_key: Makes an object under a key.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.
- [ciphers::xchacha20_poly1305](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-chacha): XChaCha20-Poly1305, authenticated encryption in place with a 24-byte nonce safe to draw at random. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/chacha20_poly1305.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aead.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: encrypt messages in a chat app, on the web and natively, each with a random nonce.
  - from_key: Makes an object under a key.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.
- [ciphers::secretbox](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secretbox): NaCl's and libsodium's `crypto_secretbox`, XSalsa20-Poly1305: authenticated encryption in place under a 32-byte key, with a 24-byte nonce safe to draw at random and no additional data. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/secretbox.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aead.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: encrypt a record or a file under one secret key, each with a random nonce, in libsodium's secret-box format.
  - from_key: Makes an object under a key.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.
- [ciphers::secretbox_xchacha20poly1305](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secretbox): libsodium's `crypto_secretbox_xchacha20poly1305`: the secret box with XChaCha20 in place of XSalsa20. Header <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/secretbox.hpp>, <webcpp/crypto/ciphers/aead.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: encrypt a record or a file under one secret key, each with a random nonce, in libsodium's secret-box format.
  - from_key: Makes an object under a key.
  - seal: Seals a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the plaintext before and the ciphertext after.
  - open: Opens a message in place: `data_bytes` holds the ciphertext before and the plaintext after.

## webcpp::crypto::curves

- [curves::secp256k1::keypair](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secp256k1): A secp256k1 key pair: made from its 32-byte secret key, which `secret()` gives back, or drawn from `random_device`; its public key, a `curves::secp256k1::public_key`; `sign(crypto::schnorr, message)` (BIP 340, its auxiliary randomness drawn or given), `sign(crypto::ecdsa_sha256, input)` (hedged too) and `sign(crypto::ecdsa_sha256_recoverable, input)`, the input a message hashed inside or `crypto::prehashed{digest}`; ECDH in three forms, `agree` (the shared x), `agree_hashed` and `agree_point`, each with a peer's `public_key`; and the x-only tweak. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/secp256k1.hpp>. Backends: libsecp256k1 (/third_party//secp256k1) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsecp256k1 on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - from_secret: Makes a key pair from a secret key, as a program that kept `secret()` loads it again.
  - generate: Generates a key pair from the system's source: draws a 32-byte secret key from the system's generator and makes the key pair from it, drawing again when the 32 bytes are not a secret key (zero or not below the group order, which happens with a probability near 2^-128), at most `max_draws` (four) draws in all.
  - public_key: The public key, which `crypto::verify` takes, and `agree` as a peer's; its `compressed()`, `uncompressed()` and `xonly()` give its bytes.
  - secret: The secret key (`secp256k1_keypair_sec`), for a program that keeps the key pair and makes it again with `from_secret`, or exports it.
  - sign: Signs with one of secp256k1's three schemes: ECDSA over SHA-256 with RFC 6979's nonce, low S, as libsecp256k1 signs; the same with the recovery id; or BIP340's Schnorr, with 32 bytes of auxiliary randomness drawn from the system's generator, as BIP340 recommends.
  - agree: ECDH with a peer's public key: the shared point's x coordinate, unhashed, as P-256's `agree` and WebCrypto's `deriveBits` give it, and what Wycheproof's ECDH vectors, Nostr's NIP-44 and other protocols that hash it themselves take.
  - agree_hashed: ECDH with a peer's public key, hashed as libsecp256k1 hashes it by default: the SHA-256 of the compressed shared point.
  - agree_point: ECDH with a peer's public key: the shared point itself, SEC1 uncompressed (0x04, x, y).
  - tweak_xonly: Tweaks this key pair in place by a 32-byte tweak t: its x-only public key P becomes P + t*G, and its secret key follows (`secp256k1_keypair_xonly_tweak_add`).
- [crypto::verify, curves::secp256k1::recover](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secp256k1): Verifies a BIP 340 signature against a `curves::secp256k1::public_key` or its 32-byte x-only form, `crypto::verify(crypto::schnorr, signature, message, key)`, or an ECDSA one against a `curves::secp256k1::public_key`, `crypto::verify(crypto::ecdsa_sha256, signature, input, public_key)`, refusing a high S; `recover(crypto::ecdsa_sha256_recoverable, signature, input)` gives the signer's key. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/secp256k1.hpp>. Backends: libsecp256k1 (/third_party//secp256k1) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsecp256k1 on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - verify: Verifies an ECDSA signature over SHA-256 with a secp256k1 public key, with libsecp256k1's static context, which allocates nothing, after its self-test.
  - recover: The public key that made a recoverable signature (`secp256k1_ecdsa_recover`), as Ethereum identifies a transaction's signer: the same inputs as `sign(crypto::ecdsa_sha256_recoverable, signing_input)`.
- [curves::secp256k1::to_der, from_der, normalize_low_s, is_low_s](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secp256k1): ECDSA's strict DER encoding, and low S as two functions, `normalize_low_s` and `is_low_s`. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/secp256k1.hpp>. Backends: libsecp256k1 (/third_party//secp256k1) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsecp256k1 on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - to_der: Encodes a compact ECDSA signature as strict DER (BIP66), with libsecp256k1's own encoder.
  - from_der: Decodes a strict DER ECDSA signature (BIP66, `secp256k1_ecdsa_signature_parse_der`) to its compact form.
  - normalize_low_s: The low-S form of a compact ECDSA signature (`secp256k1_ecdsa_signature_normalize`), the only form `crypto::verify` accepts on secp256k1; a low-S signature is returned unchanged.
  - is_low_s: Whether a compact ECDSA signature is in its low-S form, the only form `crypto::verify` accepts on secp256k1, as a protocol checks what it relays (Bitcoin's standardness); `sign` gives the low form.
- [curves::secp256k1::tweak_xonly](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-secp256k1): Tweaks an x-only public key by a 32-byte tweak a protocol computes. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/secp256k1.hpp>. Backends: libsecp256k1 (/third_party//secp256k1) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsecp256k1 on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - tweak_xonly: Tweaks an x-only public key by a 32-byte tweak t: P + t*G, with libsecp256k1's static context, which allocates nothing (`secp256k1_xonly_pubkey_tweak_add`).
- [curves::ed25519::keypair](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-ed25519): An Ed25519 key pair (RFC 8032): made from a 32-byte seed, which `secret()` gives back, or drawn from `random_device`; its public key, a `curves::ed25519::public_key`; 64-byte signatures of a message with `sign(crypto::eddsa, message)`; and its X25519 secret key. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/ed25519.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: sign and verify with Ed25519 (RFC 8032), or sign a large message in pieces with Ed25519ph.
  - from_secret: Makes a key pair from a seed, RFC 8032's secret key.
  - generate: Makes a key pair from a fresh seed, drawn from the system's generator.
  - async_from_secret: Makes a key pair from a seed, asynchronously: `from_secret` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of the free `crypto::async_from_secret<basic_keypair>`, with the same arguments, which calls it.
  - async_generate: Makes a key pair from a fresh seed, asynchronously: `generate` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of `crypto::async_generate<basic_keypair>(completion_executor, completion_token)`, which calls it.
  - public_key: The public key, which `crypto::verify` takes.
  - secret: The seed, RFC 8032's secret key, for a program that keeps the key pair and makes it again with `from_secret`, or exports it (PKCS#8 holds the seed alone).
  - sign: Signs a message with Ed25519 (RFC 8032's pure Ed25519: the message itself, of any length, empty included, is signed; no digest is taken).
  - async_sign: Signs a message with Ed25519, asynchronously: `sign` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of the free `crypto::async_sign`, with the same arguments and this key pair, which calls it.
  - x25519_secret: The X25519 secret key of this key pair, RFC 7748's form of the clamped first half of the seed's SHA-512.
- [curves::ed25519::public_key](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-ed25519): An Ed25519 public key, its 32 bytes, which `crypto::verify(crypto::eddsa, ...)` takes: made from bytes with only their size checked, since whether the point is canonical and not of small order is the verification policy's judgment. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/ed25519.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten.
  - from_bytes: Makes a public key from its 32 bytes, as RFC 8032 encodes it and WebCrypto's `exportKey("raw")` writes it.
  - bytes: The key's bytes.
  - verify: Verifies an Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032's pure Ed25519) with this key, under a verification policy (design D31): `crypto::verify(crypto::eddsa, signature_value, message_input, key, verify_policy)`, of which it is the member form, with the same work, results and refusals.
  - async_verify: Verifies an Ed25519 signature with this key, asynchronously, strictly: `verify` run when the operation is initiated, its result posted to `completion_executor`; the member form of the free `crypto::async_verify<Backend>`, with the same arguments and this key, which calls it.
- [crypto::verify](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-ed25519): Verifies an Ed25519 signature with a public key alone, `crypto::verify(crypto::eddsa, signature, message, public_key)`, under the policy `strict`: libsodium's rules, which refuse non-canonical encodings and keys of small order. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/ed25519.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: sign and verify with Ed25519 (RFC 8032), or sign a large message in pieces with Ed25519ph.
  - verify: Verifies an Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032's pure Ed25519) under a verification policy (design D31).
- [curves::ed25519::ph](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-ed25519): Ed25519ph (RFC 8032): a message given in pieces, hashed with SHA-512, then signed with a key pair or verified with `verify(signature, public_key)`. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/ed25519.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Use it to: sign and verify with Ed25519 (RFC 8032), or sign a large message in pieces with Ed25519ph.
  - begin: Begins a message.
  - update: Adds a piece of the message.
  - sign: Signs the message given, which it ends.
  - verify: Verifies a signature of the message given, which it ends, strictly (design D31).
- [curves::ed25519::to_x25519_public](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-x25519): The X25519 public key of an Ed25519 public key (the birational map), refusing a key of small order or not canonical with `invalid_public_key`. Header <webcpp/crypto/curves/ed25519.hpp>. Backends: libsodium (/third_party//sodium) on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. Default: libsodium on native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten. - [curves::p256::keypair::sign; crypto::verify, to_der, from_der, normalize_low_s, is_low_s](https://webcpporg.github.io/libs/crypto/#crypto-p256-ecdsa): ECDSA over SHA-256 with RFC 6979's nonce, `sign(crypto::ecdsa_sha256, input)` and `crypto::verify(crypto::ecdsa_sha256, signature, input, public_key)`, the input a message hashed inside or `crypto::prehashed{digest}`; the signature a `curves::p256::ecdsa_signature`, r and s, signed low S, verified whatever its S; strict DER both ways; `normalize_low_s` and `is_low_s` for a signature made elsewhere.   - sign: Signs with ECDSA over SHA-256 and RFC 6979's deterministic nonce (no random number is drawn: the same key and input give the same signature), S always low, at most (n - 1) / 2, as libsecp256k1 signs: the signature is normalized after it is made.

  - to_der: Encodes a signature as strict DER, the ECDSA-Sig-Value SEQUENCE of two INTEGERs that X.509 and OpenSSL carry.
  - from_der: Decodes a strict DER signature to its raw form: only the encoding `to_der` writes is accepted.
  - normalize_low_s: The low-S form of a signature: s replaced by n - s when s is above (n - 1) / 2, returned unchanged otherwise.
  - is_low_s: Whether a signature is in its low-S form, as a protocol that requires low S checks what it receives before `crypto::verify`, which accepts both forms; `sign` gives the low form.
